receipts.text: Your resignation is still filed as Optional. The clerk who prepared it has been reassigned to the department of unwanted freedom.
Beverly's joint safety injunction still carries both your names, in lettering too large for Legal to redact quietly.
The Nutrition Department now budgets for a designated crumb zone. Local 9 holds meetings there between lunch shifts.
Dale and you kept the silence together during the Company's loyalty test. PAL has filed that quiet as evidence.
The Founder's four spare mustaches have been returned and given four separate votes. Your name remains in the minutes as the courier.
The administrator terminal remembers an employee who gained access, though the Board has erased the time and method.
The bears are silent now. The Board has replaced its surveillance budget with a line labeled Unexpected Privacy.
Dale's torn testimony has become potting soil. The Board still asks what he meant to say about you.
Ticket Two remains In Progress. PAL has requested a definition of help that will fit on one line. No answer will satisfy it.
